propositions: FAIL remediation guidance omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence admissibility, directing operators toward futile ticket-comment-only retries on untagged external criteria.

ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md deliberately classify untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable and reject ticket-only evidence; the remediation guidance contradicts this contract by implying ticket comments will be considered without mentioning the tag requirement.

Remediation guidance must distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and explicitly name the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite and untagged external fallback constraint.

The strengthened interface test requires the exact tag and external-evidence distinction in emitted remediation; the test RED on old guidance and GREEN after fix, with mutation restoring old guidance returning RED.
